t: High quality, durable design. Provides a burn-free cut on laminate. Can also be used for pattern work. Recommended for use with hand-held and 1/4" routers. Ideal for softwood, hardwood, MDF, plywood and chipboard.
b: Suitable for Cutting Softwood, Hardwood, Laminate, Veneer Wood, Plywood, Chipboard, Fibreboard & Sandwich Material
